.AVIATION...

A zone of surface moisture convergence is leading to areas of 
patchy/shallow fog that is expanding eastward from Lake Michigan. 
MBS and FNT remain favored to see a brief period of visibility 
reduction and possibly down towards PTK until about 14Z if it 
can materialize before sunrise. High pressure then maintains clear 
skies in the lowest 15kft. Winds remain light and out of the 
southwest to start this TAF period with a more southerly wind 
direction expected by late this afternoon. Hi-res models again 
suggest the potential for patchy fog development that would mainly 
affect the southern metro terminals late tonight with the slight 
moisture boost off Lake Erie in the southerly flow. 

For DTW...The chances for fog this morning remain northwest of DTW 
with slightly better potential for fog tonight. Confidence is low for
any reduction below VFR tonight.
